target.title: fix(auth): prioritize explicit models.json apiKey over store profiles
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

When resolving a provider's credentials, the `resolveApiKeyForProvider` function checks for per-entry bindings using `resolveProviderEntryApiKeyBinding`. If the user has specified a literal API key in `models.json`, this resolves to a `literal` kind binding.

However, the function failed to check or return the resolved `literal` kind binding. Instead, it fell through to scan the global profile store. If any profiles existed for that provider (e.g. from onboarding or other agents), those profiles were used instead of the user's explicit literal key.

## Fix

Immediately handle and return the `literal` kind binding inside `resolveApiKeyForProvider` when it is resolved from `resolveProviderEntryApiKeyBinding`.

## Test plan

Added a unit test `prioritizes explicit models.json apiKey over store profiles` in `src/agents/model-auth.profiles.test.ts` to verify that literal config keys are chosen over stored profiles. Ran tests and all 72 tests passed.


## Evidence
